The F2/F2A plan on this sheet is drawn rotated 90°: 1.30 here is along building x, 1.00 / 0.50 along building y.

F2 and F2A are 0.20 slabs on 2 piles each, meshed ø9@0.20# top and bottom; the 'B0' leaders in section 2-2 point at the strip over each pile pair (dashed band in the plan). B0's section is on S-10; B0 has no position of its own on any plan, so it is recorded only as a spec here.
The concrete flight between F2A and F2 has no printed mark; recorded with an assigned name.
Sheet is image-identical to houses 61/62 (ไทยพอเพียง 6/7) S-06 — same transcription.
